# Adi Prathapa

> Aditya (Adi) Prathapa is a Computer Science student at Cornell University (AI minor) building graph ML and full stack systems, contributing to Jenkins and Kubeflow, and founding Apature, a design review tooling startup.

This site is a single page React app; the sections below describe its content.

## Sections

- [Home](https://www.adiprathapa.space/): hero, about, experience (MITRE data science intern summer 2026, Colorado School of Mines, UNL research), education (Cornell, B.A. CS)
- [Projects](https://www.adiprathapa.space/#projects): Apature (Verdict VLM design reviewer and Sigil eval statistics library), Hexmend (WebMCP agent gym disguised as a spell game), macro placement GNN, Tauron (livestock disease GNN), Helicity (stablecoin liquidity stress)
- [Open Source](https://www.adiprathapa.space/#open-source): Kiwix/openZIM, Kubeflow, Jenkins, CockroachDB contributions
- [Calendar](https://www.adiprathapa.space/calendar.html): book a meeting
- [Privacy](https://www.adiprathapa.space/privacy.html)
